help.about: A theme for YaeDock. Copy this file, change the colours, then import it in Settings > Themes. Colours are "#RRGGBB", or "#AARRGGBB" with transparency. Every key in "colors" is needed, and this "help" block can stay or go.
help.id: 1 to 32 lowercase letters, digits or dashes. Importing a file with the same id replaces it. The built-in ids (midnight, paper, void, ocean, sakura) are taken.
help.name: Shown under the preview in Settings, up to 32 characters.
help.description: One short line under the name.
help.order: Only used by built-in themes; imported ones are listed by name.
help.dark: true when the background is dark. It picks light or dark icons for the phone's status and navigation bars.
help.card: Cards on the ground: the clock, the stats, each control group.
help.raised: Buttons and chips inside a card: Screenshot, Record, the media button, unselected choices.
help.track: Empty part of gauges and sliders, dividers, and the dots of the welcome pages.
help.text: Main text and numbers. Needs 7:1 contrast on background, card and raised.
help.muted: Labels, hints and secondary lines, such as "Thursday, 5 November". Needs 4.5:1 on background, card and raised.
help.accent: Live values and the chosen thing: the greeting, sliders, gauges, the current tab, switches. Also the night clock's minutes, dimmed.
help.onAccent: Text and icons drawn on an accent fill, such as a switched-on switch or the app mark.
help.accentSoft: Behind the chosen chip or tab, under accent-coloured text.
help.accentDim: Cached memory, drawn next to used memory in the accent.
help.amber: Warm temperatures (60 to 80 °C), battery and charging, and the Performance power profile.
help.amberSoft: Behind amber chips, such as the chosen Performance profile.
help.amberText: Amber text on amberSoft and on cards.
help.red: Hot temperatures (80 °C and up), recording, and errors.
help.redSoft: Behind red buttons: Shut down, and the record button while recording.
help.redText: Red text on redSoft and on cards, such as "Shut down…".
